note: Every Italian comune — the unit the stato civile is kept in, from 1806 in the north and 1809 in the south — with its region, its province, and the HISTORIC province code, which is what an archive is filed under rather than the province of today. Comuni carrying an official second name keep it: Bolzano is Bozen, Aosta is Aoste, and a strip around Trieste and Gorizia is Slovene.
